contract.geometry: Fixed first eligible source anchor T, half-open [T,T+50ms), no extension, no target-aware early close, seal only after complete source coverage.
contract.selection: MIDI-only, lexical recording ID then chronological occurrence. Exclude every known earlier STEP used recording ID, audio SHA and MIDI SHA, including invalidated phases. Select first eligible occurrence per distinct recording per topology; no physical occurrence reuse between core READY categories. Never replace after acoustic output.
contract.truthGrouping: Existing fixed first-anchor <=35ms MIDI truth grouping only; not acoustic assembly policy.
contract.positiveMetadataRule: t>=5s and t<duration-3s; previous any-pitch note-on group ends at least200ms earlier; next group starts at least1200ms later. Original real PCM prefix starts t-4.35s. Acoustic owned start=t-3.15s, end=start+4.8s, plus real200ms tail. Predeclared semantic arm=t-150ms, never chosen from decoded output. Chord>=2 distinct pitches; close spread 0<spread<=35ms; same-pitch/repeated-chord/soft-after-loud require prior matching pitch or exact chord within3s, and soft velocity max<0.6*prior. Suppression gestures also require t>=5s to guarantee genuine context for the longest4.76s prefix. No score labels enter Stage A.
contract.negativeMetadataRule: Any-pitch note-on-free guard>=1.6s; arm=guard.start+200ms; score1200ms; preserve real context prefix from arm-4.2s. Held needs MIDI-held note, pedal needs CC64>=64; require distinct physical guards from2recordings each. No acoustic output used.
contract.suppressionMetadataRule: First eligible physical group followed by another group at250..500ms for capturing-outside,200..250ms for rapid-not-ready,700..900ms for analyzing/reset/late. Capturing-outside uses owned start=t-3.56s so the physical event is40ms before a window end and H can cross publication coverage; no output-dependent shifting. Other cases use owned start=t-3.15s. Preserve waveform/internal timing. These are NOT READY acceptance cases. Analyze/reset holds and late receipts use predeclared source-sample scripts, no attempt queue. Rapid/pre-lock inputs are reported separately from actual busy wall-state witnesses.
contract.causalReady: Replay supplies real prefix PCM while semantic input is unavailable. At a predeclared integer source watermark, finish required startup analysis before arming; do not feed future selected user-event PCM until semantic READY has actually occurred. Source timestamps and all waveform/internal spacing stay fixed. Record actual READY source watermark and wall availability independently. Never compare unrelated wall/source origins or shift an event after inference.
contract.rearm: Explicit authoritative physically supplied source-sample watermark through all busy capture; not analyzed frontier or Worker completion time. Equality ineligible. No queued replay.
contract.truthIsolation: Stage A browser allowlist: PCM, numeric source arming script, production model/FIR/ORT/Worker/runtime and score-blind assembly only. Seal SHA256 and read-only acoustic output before Stage B parses MIDI truth/constructs targets/calls production StepPracticeRuntime.
contract.counterfactuals: Post-seal only: exact physical set P, subset(remove highest), superset(add lowest absent piano pitch), replace highest with nearest absent semitone/octave; repeated target sentinels expose unsupported later advances.
contract.gate: All counters zero; no attempt/MATCH in READY negative guards; zero invalid READY positives; each core READY topology has corroborated exact-target MATCH at both rates; Continuous regression and full static verification PASS. Missing metadata family/independent-source minimum blocks BEFORE neural execution.
contract.previousResult: STEP_ACOUSTIC_WAITING_ATTEMPT_SAFETY_NOT_ESTABLISHED remains historically valid; not reclassified as PASS.
